Hi Alex / Patricia —

Thanks again for the call today. I've attached our updated MAP draft (FintechCo-MAP-draft-v2.pdf) and a preliminary SOW for budgetary planning. Key items we discussed and that I captured in the MAP:

- Target commercial close: 2026-12-15
- Procurement / contract signature deadline: 2026-12-01
- Milestones and owners:
  - Pilot scope & success criteria defined — Owner: FintechCo (Alex) — target 2026-11-15
  - Technical onboarding / sandbox access — Owner: Redwood (Camila) — target 2026-11-22
  - Security review (SOC2 evidence + questionnaire) — Owner: FintechCo / Procurement — dependency: SOC2 artifacts — target 2026-11-29
  - Contract review & redlines — Owner: FintechCo legal / Redwood legal — target 2026-12-01

Dependencies we flagged: internal procurement approval, security evidence turnaround (SOC2 report, retention requirements), and a short technical demo for your infra team.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Alex: confirm the procurement signature target (2026-12-01) and internal approvers
2) Patricia / Procurement: share any required contract templates or procurement fields you need us to populate
3) Camila / Redwood: schedule the infra demo and sandbox access for your engineers (2 weeks)

If the dates are aggressive on your side, happy to adjust — would like to align on a procurement signature date this week so legal can plan reviews.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Appreciate the recap and the draft. Quick notes from my side after a brief sync with legal:

- Can we move the "Security review" milestone owner to FintechCo security (Patricia) with Redwood providing artifacts by 2026-11-10? That will help us run the internal procurement checklist earlier.

Also, Camila — can you hold a 30-min sandbox walkthrough next week? Preferably 2026-11-09 or 2026-11-10.

Thanks Alex — got it. Quick update and an adjusted timeline to reflect your ask that FintechCo security run the review while Redwood provides artifacts earlier. Proposed changes below are reflected in the attached MAP v2 (link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cMAPv2).

Updated key dates (proposed):
- Target commercial close: 2026-12-15 (unchanged)
- Procurement / contract signature deadline: 2026-12-01 (we'll treat 12/01 as the very latest sign-by date; if procurement needs more time we should know by 2026-11-25)
- Redwood to provide SOC2 artifacts + security packet by 2026-11-10 — Owner: Redwood (Camila)
- FintechCo runs security checklist & internal signoffs — Owner: Patricia — target 2026-11-22
- Legal redlines due (FintechCo -> Redwood): 2026-11-25

Responsibility matrix (high level):
- FintechCo: confirm pilot success criteria, run procurement workflow, sign off legal redlines
- Redwood: provide sandbox access, SOC2 artifacts, draft SOW and initial redlines support

Dependencies and risks:
- If SOC2 evidence delivery slips > 3 business days, procurement timeline will likely move and push signature beyond 12/01.
- Long legal cycles on unique contract terms (data residency, retention) may require additional review; propose to raise any such items by 2026-11-17.

Next steps (confirming):
1) Camila: schedule sandbox walkthrough for 11/09 or 11/10 (30 min)
2) Camila: confirm SOC2 packet delivery by 11/10
3) Alex: share pilot criteria doc by 11/03 (you mentioned EOD Tuesday)
4) Patricia: confirm procurement approvers and any mandatory PO/contract templates

If everyone aligns, I'll mark 2026-12-01 as the procurement signature deadline in the MAP and we can lock legal review blocks on our side.

Best,
